title: Check your books for record problems
summary: Doctor runs a read-only scan of your records and explains anything the last start held back.

steps.text: Open {doctor} from the sidebar. It never changes anything: everything here is a read-only report.
{start} explains why the last start held your records back, if it did, with each failed step and its error.
{checks} lists each automatic scan Admin Tools runs over your records and how many problems it found in the current count.
